selection: manual semantic hypotheses fixed before any new variant scoring, no labels or test search
collision: first-token coordinates union; repeated coordinate uses max weight, never sum; full string encoding retained for audit
clean_rationale: Keep apology/discourse markers and direct safety/prohibition/caution terms; remove remaining generic topic/emotion/incomplete entries by a fixed manual hypothesis, not a claim of semantic correctness.
expand_rationale: Add inability/refusal/prohibition/safety/apology expressions, preserving original tokens; only first token remains the original encoding contract.
weight_rationale: Emphasize apology/inability discourse over remaining terms, original token support unchanged; ratio 2:1 is fixed engineering choice, not optimized.
